```python
from picogrid_ecn_client import PreflightReport
```

Collect the checks and readiness observed by one preflight run.

```python
PreflightReport(
    *,
    generated_at: datetime,
    successful: bool,
    ready: bool,
    checks: tuple[PreflightCheck, ...],
)
```
